answer_1.quote: To comprehensively evaluate multilingual capability, especially considering the real-world usage, we propose a Dual Evaluation framework in this paper, which decomposes the multilingual capability evaluation along two critical dimensions: (1) linguistic medium (the language used for questioning) and (2) cultural context (the regional and cultural knowledge being tested).

answer_2.quote: We apply non-weighted scores for the evaluation metrics.

answer_4.quote: We would also like to thank Yizhe Yang from Beijing Institute of Technology for helping us with human evaluation.
answer_4.guideline: The details of the completion for Q i,j and human evaluation for the quality are presented in Appendix A.4.
